en:
Amago Haruhisa's army made camp
on Mount Aomitsui, facing Koriyama.
On its flanks waited the forces of
Amago allies Takeda Nobushige and
Kikkawa Okitsune, and Haruhisa's
uncle Kunihisa was ordered to
spearhead the attack on Koriyama.
But Ouchi Yoshitaka's relief army
had still not appeared at Koriyama...
Sho no Jiro took the field.
